title: Verification record, version 4
description: What our tools established about one record on one date. Written by `osd verify`, never by hand. The level is the highest level whose every check passed.

level.description: L0 listed; L1 origin reachable; L2 files checksummed and licence text captured; L3 outlines extracted by a reader; L4 converted to a canonical type with a fidelity record

reachability.description: v2. blocked: 403/429 or a challenge page, awards no level (OSD-D9); ok: 2xx/3xx on the origin host; moved: 2xx/3xx on another host; dead: anything else (timeouts, refused connections and 5xx after one retry)

blocked_since.description: v2. First check of the current unbroken blocked run

partial_exports.description: v4 (E23). Generated exports the server truncated (exceededTransferLimit): hashed, but never a file of the record and never counted for L2

licence_text.description: v2. The visible licence text the hash was computed over, whitespace collapsed

inventory.description: v3 (E07). Only for records with a `mirror:` rule in verifier/samples.yaml: every listing entry the rule selects; each hashed one is in `files`. complete: all selected entries hashed in this run (a claim about this selection, never the whole dataset)

selected.description: Paths as the listing states them

publisher_checksum.description: v4 (E23). The checksum the publisher's listing states for this file, verbatim

compared.description: v4. true: the publisher's algorithm (md5, sha1 or sha256) was computed over the same bytes and compared; false: unsupported algorithm or malformed digest, recorded only

partial.description: v4. Only in partial_exports: the server truncated this generated export
